summary: No Sabah-specific signal was identified in the sources reviewed: the Human Dignity Trust Malaysia profile (last updated 16 December 2025) and the Human Rights Watch and Justice for Sisters report of 10 August 2022 document the national framework only, and the national assessment applies to Sabah.

localsOnly: No resident-facing finding specific to Sabah was identified in the sources reviewed.
outOfScopeNotes: Both sources are national in scope. Whether any Sabah religious-law provision, state religious authority or state-level enforcement practice departs from the national pattern is unresolved and not sourced here.
